proof_body:
by
  intro a F l u hF h1 h2 h n hn
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  | succ n hn ih =>
    rw [h n hn]
    exact hF (a n) ih.1 ih.2
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (l u : ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, l ≤ x → x ≤ u → l ≤ F x ∧ F x ≤ u) → l ≤ a 1 → a 1 ≤ u → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = F (a n)) → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → l ≤ a n ∧ a n ≤ u
